ASC 820 establishes a fair value hierarchy that requires an enty to maximize the use of observable inputs and minimize the use of unobservable inputs when measuring fair value. An asset's or a liability's categorizaon within the fair value hierarchy is based upon the lowest level of input that is significant to the fair value measurement.
